audit: DOA Developer key inventory — origin, consumer and disposition
why: Every DOA key carried created_by = 11111111-2222-4333-8444-555555555555, the synthetic actor of the internal fixture route. Working is not the same as publicly reproducible: a reference application whose credentials cannot be obtained the public way is a reference to something nobody else can build.

four_versus_three_explained: The fourth key was never a DOA credential. rf-pub-2823621781 was minted by the published-SDK refund harness on the DOA Sandbox project (its three calls land exactly in that harness's run window at 21:47) and left behind by a run whose cleanup did not match its name. It is a fixture leak, not a consumer. So the canonical set is three, and the three public-origin replacements map one to one.
disclosure: It was revoked during the orphan sweep, classified by name pattern, BEFORE this full usage analysis was run. The analysis confirms the classification; the ordering is recorded rather than presented as if the evidence came first.
